paper_title: Search for QCD coupled axion dark matter with the MICROSCOPE space experiment
notes: Paper constrains axion-gluon coupling (1/f_a) via QCD-coupled axion dark matter through equivalence principle tests. The coupling is to gluons (QCD), not photons, making AxionPhoton technically incorrect; however, the paper's primary result is on the f_a-m_a plane (coupling strength vs mass), and no standard enum value exists for 'AxionGluon' or 'AxionQCD'. The paper explicitly states constraints on '1/f_a' (the Peccei-Quinn scale) as a function of axion mass m_a. Data points extracted from abstract ('10^-17 eV to 10^-13 eV range', '1/f_a ~ 1.7 × 10^-16 GeV^-1 at 10^-20 eV', '1/f_a ~ 1.3 × 10^-10 GeV^-1 at m_a ~ 7.7 × 10^-14 eV') and main text. The constraint shows multiple bands due to resonances and sign changes in the axion field gradient. DM density ρ_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 is used in the theoretical model (Eq. 16). Confidence level is 95% as stated in the paper. Extraction confidence is moderate (0.65) because: (1) the coupling type is technically AxionGluon/AxionQCD, not AxionPhoton, but no exact enum match exists; (2) data points are approximate from text rather than a detailed table; (3) the non-linear relationship between γ and 1/f_a and the presence of resonance bands make precise point extraction difficult. The paper is a genuine new experimental limit from MICROSCOPE final data. | selector: text (sole candidate)
